svg.title: LLM Council architecture
svg.desc: Case file, orchestrator with ingest, specialists, code checks, judges, red team, chair, report checks and human gate; an LLM gateway that all model calls pass through; model APIs, run folder and clickable report page.
svg.text: Synthetic data only. Decision support, a human signs off.
